text_block_list.text:
After facing off against Eishin Flash at 
the Arima Kinen, Gold Ship proudly raised 
her big-catch flag in triumph. True to 
their promise, she received a new secret 
tome.

Eden lies on the ocean floor, and 
gathering four keywords by battling the 
mighty will lead the way. So the tome 
wrote. It sounds ridiculously fishy.

A secret tome whose author and origins 
remain unknown to this day. Still, there's 
no choice but to push forward. Gold Ship, 
Eden is waiting for you... I feel like it 
is, anyway!
